query:
INSERT INTO mn.peers (multiaddr, public_key, ip_address, port, last_seen_at, is_active)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW(), TRUE)
        ON CONFLICT (multiaddr) DO UPDATE SET
            public_key = EXCLUDED.public_key,
            ip_address = EXCLUDED.ip_address,
            port = EXCLUDED.port,
            last_seen_at = NOW(),
            is_active = TRUE
